_comment: Finds from the Discord pass (2026-11-02): mods the community uses with the lewd mods that the catalog did not have. Identity checked against the public Workshop data (raw/steam_items.json) or the hidden-item data (raw/steam_hidden.json).

mods.name: High elf red line buffs for dark elf units
mods.summary: Adds Dark Elf units to the High Elves' red-line lord skills and Shades to Alith Anar's unique skills, so High Elf lords with confederated Dark Elf armies get their buffs.

steam.title: High elf red line buffs for dark elf units

installNotes: Not part of Lazy's Morathi progression and not needed for it; Readman's Alarielle lists use it for mixed High Elf and Dark Elf armies.

mods.name: Miao Ying - Keeper of Secrets form
mods.summary: After Miao Ying reaches corruption stage 6 and a few breeding events, her battle transformation becomes a Keeper of Secrets instead of her dragon.

packs.note: Pack name from the Discord copy.

relations.note: Needs Lazy's Miao Ying mods and stage 6.

installNotes: Only replaces the battle transformation (not permanent, not her campaign model). The model comes from Lin's Corrupted Ascension. A Russian translation is built into the SEU Reborn translation (Steam 3749585405).

openQuestions: The author also mentioned a requirement on the Defiled Broodmother mod on Discord; the Workshop text names only Lazy's Miao Ying mods.

mods.name: Citadel of Dusk Standalone (Dust)
mods.summary: The Citadel of Dusk as a playable High Elf faction with its own lord and hero, taken out of Dust's Corrupted Heroes as a standalone item.

relations.note: Dust's Corrupted Heroes contains the same faction since its 2026-10-30 update; use one of the two.

installNotes: The lord and hero spawn on turn 1; adding the mod to a running campaign does not give them (summon them with the console), but it does not break the save.
knownIssues: The faction's lord Melvina plays her male counterpart's voice lines in diplomacy (author aware, as of 2026-10-30).

mods.name: Bucket's Better Victory Messages
mods.summary: Rewrites the text shown after a battle for each victory and defeat class.
installNotes: The unlisted Slaanesh-themed version (3629045053) replaces the messages for all factions, so use it only when playing Slaanesh; use one of the two versions.

mods.name: Legendary Heroes: Battle for Warhammer
mods.summary: Thirteen new legendary heroes inspired by another fantasy series, unlocked through events for many factions.
installNotes: Made compatible with Corrupted Landmarks on 2025-12-13 (Corrupted Landmarks' maintainer). Its Wood Elf part uses the same mechanic as the Kerberos mods, so a conflict there cannot be fully fixed.

mods.name: Drycha Reskin (Lin)
mods.summary: Lin's new model for Drycha on its own, without the Nurgle corruption campaign of Lin's Corrupted Drycha.
installNotes: Recommended by the Alarielle, Temptation's Bloom author for players who want Drycha's model changed without the Nurgle progression; Lin's Corrupted Drycha already brings the model.

openQuestions: Whether it can run next to Lin's Corrupted Drycha is not stated.

mods.name: Autoresolve Quest Battles
mods.summary: Lets quest battles be auto-resolved (updated for patch 9.0, multiplayer compatible).

steam.title: Autoresolve Quest Battles UPDATED 9.0 | MP Compatible

installNotes: The Alarielle, Temptation's Bloom author points to it for getting past a broken quest battle so the campaign can go on.

mods.name: Korean translation bundle for the corruption mods
mods.summary: Korean translation of many corruption mods in one pack (machine translated, then reviewed); abandoned mods were dropped in the latest update.
installNotes: The uploader keeps Community Beastmen and Corrupted Ascension in separate translation items. Enable only the translations of mods you actually use; with every translated mod enabled at once script errors are expected.

mods.name: Beastmen: Beastpaths Underways
mods.summary: Adds the Beastpaths underway network for Beastmen.

relations.note: Also part of 'The Underways: Compilation'; enable only one of the two.

installNotes: Several Community Beastmen players use it and report it as compatible and helpful for reaching and capturing legendary lords.
